description: Sale-side parity: add TaxInvoiceScreen, DocumentCancellationScreen, ShiftGateScreen, LicenseActivationScreen; extend storeConfigStore with license fields; wire SaleNavigator (TaxInvoice + DocumentCancellation + optional Receipt->TaxInvoice button); add native license gate to App.tsx. Depends on FEAT nothing in code but MUST run before FEAT-003 because it adds the license fields (licenseKey/licenseActivated/activateLicense) to storeConfigStore that WebLicenseScreen reads. Follow sibling SALE/AUTH screen conventions (SafeAreaView + colored header + Ionicons back + ScrollView + StyleSheet with real tokens). Thai UI; loading/error/empty states; no `any` abuse.
steps: Extend src/store/storeConfigStore.ts: add state fields `licenseKey: string` (default '') and `licenseActivated: boolean` (default false) to StoreConfigState and the initial state object; add action `activateLicense: (key: string) => boolean` that trims the key, returns false if length < 6, else sets {licenseKey:key, licenseActivated:true}, calls logAction('ตั้งค่า','เปิดใช้งาน License', 'เปิดใช้งานด้วยคีย์ ...'), returns true. Keep existing persist name 'pos-store-config'. getStoreConfig() already exposes state.

Create src/screens/auth/LicenseActivationScreen.tsx: `export const LicenseActivationScreen: React.FC<{ onActivated: () => void }>`. Top: Ionicons 'storefront-outline' + a Typography heading (คีย์ใบอนุญาต / เปิดใช้งานระบบ). Body: Input (label 'คีย์ใบอนุญาต / รหัสเปิดใช้งาน', value state, autoCapitalize off), Button title 'เปิดใช้งาน License' (fullWidth, loading while activating). onPress: call useStoreConfigStore.getState().activateLicense(key); if true call onActivated(); else set inline error (styled View + Ionicons 'alert-circle-outline' + Thai 'คีย์ใบอนุญาตไม่ถูกต้อง'). Loading state via useState. Use Colors/Typography/Spacing/BorderRadius tokens; mirror AuthLayout/LoginScreen look (centered card on web, column on mobile).

Create src/screens/sale/TaxInvoiceScreen.tsx: `export const TaxInvoiceScreen: React.FC<{ saleNo: string; onBack: () => void; onCancelInvoice: () => void }>`. Pull sale = useSaleHistoryStore(s=>s.getSaleByNo)(saleNo). Read shop info from useStoreConfigStore (storeName/storeAddress/storeTaxId) with useReceiptStore fallback. If !sale: empty/error state (SafeAreaView + header + centered Ionicons 'document-outline' + Thai 'ไม่พบข้อมูลการขาย' + ย้อนกลับ button). Else render ใบกำกับภาษีเต็มรูป: header bar (title 'ใบกำกับภาษีเต็มรูป' + back), editable buyer Inputs (ชื่อผู้ซื้อ, เลขประจำตัวผู้เสียภาษี, ที่อยู่) via useState, seller block, invoice number (derive e.g. 'TAX'+saleNo), line items from sale.items (name, qty x unitPrice, amount), VAT 7% breakdown computed from VAT-included totals (base = grandTotal/1.07, vat = grandTotal - base; also show sale.vatAmount), grand total. Buttons: ย้อนกลับ (onBack), พิมพ์ใบกำกับภาษี (build an HTML invoice string and print: on web window.open('','_blank') + write + print() like ShiftScreen.printShiftReport; on native use Print.printToFileAsync+Sharing from 'expo-print'/'expo-sharing' like src/utils/exportReport.ts), ยกเลิกใบกำกับภาษี (onCancelInvoice). Use formatCurrency/formatDateTime from src/utils/format. Follow ReceiptScreen StyleSheet/token conventions.

Create src/screens/sale/DocumentCancellationScreen.tsx: `export const DocumentCancellationScreen: React.FC<{ saleNo: string; documentType: string; onBack: () => void; onDone: () => void }>`. docTypeLabel map: tax_invoice->'ใบกำกับภาษี', receipt->'ใบเสร็จ', default->documentType. Modal-style card: title 'ยกเลิกเอกสาร', show saleNo + docTypeLabel, reason field via <Input multiline numberOfLines={3} label='เหตุผลการยกเลิก'> (required). ยืนยันการยกเลิก Button: if reason.trim() empty set inline error (Thai 'กรุณากรอกเหตุผลการยกเลิก') and return; else call useSaleHistoryStore.getState().voidSale(saleNo, reason) then onDone(). ปิด/ยกเลิก Button -> onBack(). Thai labels, tokens, sibling conventions.

Create src/screens/sale/ShiftGateScreen.tsx: `export const ShiftGateScreen: React.FC` (props {}). Read useShiftStore (isShiftOpen, currentShift, openShift). Read cashier name from useAuthStore (user?.name ?? 'พนักงาน'). If isShiftOpen(): show status card 'กะเปิดอยู่' with openingAmount. Else: prominent card with Ionicons 'time-outline', heading 'ยังไม่ได้เปิดกะการขาย', เงินทอนเริ่มกะ input (decimal-pad), and a prominent เปิดกะการขาย Button (min height ComponentSize.button.md=44) calling openShift({posId:'pos1', posName:'POS 1', cashierName, openingAmount: parseFloat(input)||0}). Loading state while store hydrates (optional useState), empty-input guard. Match ShiftScreen visual/token conventions.

Wire src/navigation/SaleNavigator.tsx (W1): import TaxInvoiceScreen + DocumentCancellationScreen. Extend SaleStackParamList with `TaxInvoice: { saleNo: string }` and `DocumentCancellation: { saleNo: string; documentType: string }`. Add <Stack.Screen name='TaxInvoice'> rendering TaxInvoiceScreen saleNo={route.params.saleNo} onBack={goBack} onCancelInvoice={()=>navigation.navigate('DocumentCancellation',{saleNo:route.params.saleNo,documentType:'tax_invoice'})}. Add <Stack.Screen name='DocumentCancellation' options={{presentation:'modal'}}> rendering DocumentCancellationScreen with saleNo+documentType from route, onBack={goBack}, onDone={()=>navigation.navigate('Receipt',{saleNo:route.params.saleNo,payments:[]})}. In the existing Receipt screen registration, pass onTaxInvoice={()=>props.navigation.navigate('TaxInvoice',{saleNo:props.route.params.saleNo})}.

In src/screens/sale/ReceiptScreen.tsx add an OPTIONAL prop `onTaxInvoice?: () => void` to ReceiptScreenProps and, only when provided, render an extra action button 'ออกใบกำกับภาษีเต็มรูป' (outline style, Ionicons 'document-text-outline') in the existing actions block calling onTaxInvoice. Do NOT change the existing {saleNo, payments} params or other behavior.

Wire license gate in App.tsx (W2, native path only): change `type MobileState = 'loading' | 'auth' | 'main'` to include 'license'. Import LicenseActivationScreen and getStoreConfig from storeConfigStore. In the native splash-timeout effect, when leaving 'loading' choose 'auth' if getStoreConfig().licenseActivated else 'license'. Add render branch: when appState==='license' render <LicenseActivationScreen onActivated={()=>setAppState('auth')}/> (wrapped in SafeAreaProvider/StatusBar/ErrorBoundary like the others). Keep 'auth'->AuthNavigator onAuthSuccess and 'main'->MainNavigator exactly as-is. Do NOT alter the Platform.OS==='web' branch. Preserve the existing hook ordering (the useState<MobileState> stays where it is after the web return).
acceptance_criteria: Files exist and export the exact named components with the exact prop signatures: TaxInvoiceScreen {saleNo,onBack,onCancelInvoice}, DocumentCancellationScreen {saleNo,documentType,onBack,onDone}, ShiftGateScreen (no props), LicenseActivationScreen {onActivated}.
storeConfigStore exposes licenseKey, licenseActivated, activateLicense; activateLicense('') returns false and activateLicense('ABC123') returns true and sets licenseActivated.

SaleStackParamList has TaxInvoice and DocumentCancellation with correct param types; both screens registered; DocumentCancellation uses presentation:'modal'. ReceiptScreen still accepts {saleNo,payments} (unchanged) plus optional onTaxInvoice.
App.tsx MobileState includes 'license' and renders LicenseActivationScreen before 'auth' on native, skipping to 'auth' when licenseActivated is true; web branch unchanged.
npx tsc --noEmit total error count stays <= 13 and no error references any file created/edited in this feature.
verification: npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String "error TS" | Measure-Object  (expect Count <= 13; inspect that none of the lines reference TaxInvoiceScreen, DocumentCancellationScreen, ShiftGateScreen, LicenseActivationScreen, storeConfigStore, SaleNavigator, ReceiptScreen, App.tsx)
npm run test   (expect no new failures vs baseline)
findings: DONE. storeConfigStore (src/store/storeConfigStore.ts) now exposes: state fields `licenseKey: string` (default '') and `licenseActivated: boolean` (default false); action `activateLicense: (key: string) => boolean` (trims key, returns false if trimmed length < 6, else sets {licenseKey, licenseActivated:true} and logAction('ตั้งค่า','เปิดใช้งาน License',...)). Persist name unchanged 'pos-store-config'. getStoreConfig() exposes all of these. SaleStackParamList additions (src/navigation/SaleNavigator.tsx) for FEAT-003/integration: `TaxInvoice: { saleNo: string }` and `DocumentCancellation: { saleNo: string; documentType: string }` (DocumentCancellation registered with presentation:'modal'). ReceiptScreen now accepts optional `onTaxInvoice?: () => void` (existing {saleNo, payments} params unchanged); SaleNavigator passes onTaxInvoice -> navigate('TaxInvoice',{saleNo}). New screens exported: TaxInvoiceScreen {saleNo,onBack,onCancelInvoice}, DocumentCancellationScreen {saleNo,documentType,onBack,onDone}, ShiftGateScreen (no props), LicenseActivationScreen {onActivated}. App.tsx MobileState extended to include 'license'; native splash routes to 'license' unless getStoreConfig().licenseActivated, then LicenseActivationScreen onActivated -> 'auth'; web branch untouched. Verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` error count = 13 (== baseline), none referencing feature files; `npm run test` = 39 passed with the same 3 pre-existing suite-load failures (engine.test.ts, SyncService.test.ts, branchPermissionStore.test.ts — react-native/index.js vite import-analysis error, unrelated to this feature). NOTE: WebLicenseScreen (FEAT-003) can read licenseKey/licenseActivated and call activateLicense from useStoreConfigStore/getStoreConfig.
